creators.name: Nima Zargham
creators.role: Researcher, Digital Media Lab, University of Bremen
creators.bio: HCI and games researcher in Rainer Malaka's Digital Media Lab, working on speech interaction and conversational agents in games.
creators.why: Ran one of the larger player studies (N = 48) of LLM-driven, speech-based NPCs in VR.
creators.role_zh: 不来梅大学数字媒体实验室研究者

works.title: Look2React
works.description: VR NPCs that react to what they actually see: when the player looks at and approaches an NPC, a snapshot of the NPC's view goes to a vision-based reasoning model, which picks a body pose and a line of dialogue in response to the player's pose and the situation.
works.description_zh: 能对所见作出反应的 VR NPC：当玩家注视并走近 NPC 时，NPC 视角的画面会被送进一个基于视觉的推理模型，由它根据玩家的姿势和当时的情境选择身体姿态和一句台词。
works.idea_en: Giving characters eyes, triggered by gaze and proximity as in stealth games, lets them respond to body language at a cost low enough to run only when it matters.
works.idea_zh: 像潜行游戏那样用注视和距离来触发，给角色一双“眼睛”，它们就能回应肢体语言，而且成本低到只在需要时运行。
works.method: Gaze- and proximity-based triggering captures the NPC's view and sends it to a vision-language reasoning model that selects a pose and a text response; in an RPG compared with NPCs modelled on contemporary games (N = 20), players interacted more often and repeatedly and reported significantly higher social presence.
works.method_zh: 以注视和距离触发，截取 NPC 的视角画面送入视觉语言推理模型，由其选择姿态与文本回应；在一款 RPG 中与仿照当代游戏的 NPC 对比（N = 20），玩家与 NPC 的互动更频繁、更多次，报告的社会临场感显著更高。

paper.title: Look2React: Making VR NPCs Come Alive with Dynamic Vision-Guided Reactions

works.title: Dialogs with GenAI NPCs
works.description: Office Whispers is a speech-based VR adventure-puzzle game on Quest 2 in which players solve a mystery by talking freely with four Inworld-driven NPCs (a manager, a maintenance worker, a designer and an intern); 48 players in Canada and the Netherlands were surveyed and interviewed.
works.description_zh: Office Whispers 是一款运行在 Quest 2 上的语音 VR 解谜冒险游戏，玩家通过与四个由 Inworld 驱动的 NPC（经理、维修工、设计师和实习生）自由交谈来解开谜团；研究者对加拿大和荷兰的 48 名玩家进行了问卷与访谈。
works.idea_en: Free speech with NPCs made players feel immersed until the conversation failed: 77% hit speech-recognition errors, and wrong or off-context answers broke the game more often than latency did.
works.idea_zh: 与 NPC 自由对话让玩家感到沉浸，直到对话出错：77% 的人遇到过语音识别错误，而错误或离题的回答比延迟更常打断游戏。
works.method: Inworld provides speech recognition, dialogue memory and LLM replies with voiced output; exploratory study, N = 48, with the Player Experience Inventory, a custom questionnaire and semi-structured interviews, across two gender-swapped versions of the cast.
works.method_zh: 由 Inworld 提供语音识别、对话记忆和大语言模型回复，并以语音输出；探索性研究，N = 48，使用玩家体验量表（PXI）、自编问卷和半结构化访谈，角色设置有两个互换性别的版本。

paper.title: Dialogs with GenAI NPCs: Exploring Player Interactions with Speech Agents in a VR Game

leads.name: But How Would AI Agents Run a Town's Economy? (Regmi et al., 2026-09)
leads.why: 100 LLM agents run a money-conserving economy on real Pokhara geography for 26 simulated weeks (91 runs, 2.44M decisions): swapping the LLM changes every outcome, deleting memory changes none. Strong evidence on agent-society validity, but text simulation without video.
